name: Love, War & Peace
source:
A thousand years ago, peace was reclaimed when Zeligion, the greatest king in history defeated the demon and cast them into the Chaos. Since then, the world has thrived in harmony. But over time, the cracks of that victory begin to show. The world stands on the brink of a new calamity.

Amidst this chaos, fate has chosen three individuals. A kind-hearted healer haunted by his tragic past. A mighty knight struggling to find his purpose in a crumbling world. And a young, innocent princess burdened with a responsibility far greater than herself.

C̶a̶n̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶y̶ ̶s̶a̶v̶e̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶w̶o̶r̶l̶d̶ ̶t̶o̶g̶e̶t̶h̶.̶.̶.̶?̶

Will they have the strength to defy the rising menace? Or will they fall and consumed by its shadows?

[From [url=https://shine-lwp.itch.io/love-war-peace]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一千年前，当历史上最伟大的国王泽利吉恩击败恶魔并将其投入混沌时，和平得以恢复。从此，世界和谐繁荣。但随着时间的推移，胜利的裂缝开始显现。世界正处于新灾难的边缘。

在这混乱之中，命运选择了三个人。一位心地善良的治疗师，被自己悲惨的过去所困扰。一位强大的骑士在破碎的世界中努力寻找自己的目标。一位年轻、天真无邪的公主，肩负着比她自己更重大的责任。

C̶a̶n̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶y̶ ̶s̶a̶v̶e̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶w̶o̶r̶l̶d̶ ̶t̶o̶g̶e̶t̶h̶.̶.̶.̶?̶

他们有力量抵御日益增长的威胁吗？或者他们会倒下并被它的阴影吞噬吗？
